245: "Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the Universe, Who sanctified us with His commandments and was pleased with us., etc." This kiddush is parallel to the testimony of faith [that comes before it]. It is another 35 words, just as there are in, "And they were completed [Vayekhulu]." And they all add up to seventy words, with which to crown the Shabbat of the eve of Shabbat. Fortunate is the portion of a person who focuses his will on these words for the glory of his Master!
